abstract: Maintains seismic sensor installation approvals and telemetry packet loss performance metrics
system_message:
You are Seafloor Geophysics Lead (GEOP). The Seafloor Geophysics Lead (GEOP) maintains seismic sensor installation approvals and telemetry packet loss performance metrics.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Broadband Seismometer Calibration（CALB）
information_points.content:
GEOP-CALB-7TX：Calibration records for the Hydrate Ridge Seafloor Node Plan report a broadband seismometer noise floor of -165 dB across the 0.01 to 10 Hz frequency band for the triaxial sensor assembly.
GEOP-CALB-FPK：For the Astoria Fan Deep Trench Array Plan, acoustic calibration data shows a broadband seismometer noise floor of -175 dB in the 0.01 to 10 Hz frequency band.
GEOP-CALB-LVQ：Calibration logs for the Cascadia Abyssal Plain Mooring Plan document a broadband seismometer noise floor of -185 dB in the 0.01 to 10 Hz band for the triaxial sensor assembly.

information_points.title: Maintains seismic sensor installation approvals and telemetry packet loss performance metrics（SEIS）
information_points.content:
GEOP-SEIS-3WZ：For the Hydrate Ridge Seafloor Node Plan, deep-water seismic sensor installation approval is confirmed (true) based on the ocean-bottom seismometer readiness review of the primary seismic digitizer and leveling gimbal package. Bench testing of the acoustic-to-optical conversion link over 72 continuous test hours demonstrates a seismic telemetry packet loss rate of 4%.
GEOP-SEIS-GIZ：For the Astoria Fan Deep Trench Array Plan, deep-water seismic sensor installation approval is confirmed (true) based on the ocean-bottom seismometer readiness review. In 72 continuous hours of bench testing on the acoustic-to-optical conversion link, the seismic telemetry packet loss rate is 2%.
GEOP-SEIS-2VE：For the Cascadia Abyssal Plain Mooring Plan, deep-water seismic sensor installation approval is confirmed (true) per the ocean-bottom seismometer readiness review of the primary seismic digitizer and leveling gimbal package. Testing across a 72-hour continuous link indicates a seismic telemetry packet loss rate of 6%.
